question: Is capture work inside the active hold the dominant cause of delayed fresh observation after owner-enforced authority expiry?

arms.capture_hold: dual-lifetime executor with unchanged capture-coupled hold
arms.quiet_hold: same dual-lifetime executor and owner deadline; only in-hold snapshots are removed

primary: verified owner release -> candidate passive post-authority full-observation capture
hard_gates: zero input admissions after verified release
exactly one post-authority observation within lifecycle budget
terminal authority_ended with owner reason expired
five-field final scorer agreement all sessions

decision.PROMOTE_QUIET_HOLD_MECHANISM: all hard gates pass and paired median fresh-capture improvement >=10 ms with median deadline-to-empty regression <=2 ms
decision.HOLD: gates pass but threshold not met

stop_rule: one smoke pair then exactly three fresh matched pairs; no retry/extension for favorable result
